stories.title: Zach Bryan wears a "Free Palestine" shirt at Gillette Stadium
stories.summary: Country star Zach Bryan played his show at Gillette Stadium, home of the Patriots and owner Robert Kraft, in a "Free Palestine" T-shirt that filled the big screens. Pop Crave's photo got 165K likes and "Zach Bryan" was the top trend on X that night. Reactions split between praise and criticism, with plenty of jokes about Kraft, a prominent supporter of Israel, watching from his suite.
